scripts.build: npm --prefix packages/tracker run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.setup:web: npm --prefix apps/web ci && npm --prefix packages/tracker ci
scripts.format: prettier --write "apps/web/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}" && uv run ruff format apps scripts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "apps/web/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}" && uv run ruff format --check apps scripts
